(3) Changed in 15.0.0 and not modelled: legacy kern (and fallback kern) applies only for fallback-position shapers (affects kerning in other runs on kern faces such as Helvetica, not mark advances); trak applies by default when a font has trak and STAT (Lucida Grande, Helvetica and Menlo .ttc have neither, so no effect on these faces); position_cluster skips hidden and default-ignorable glyphs when looking for a base (a mark after such a glyph in a Hebrew/Arabic run); is_default_ignorable adds U+180F; hb_ot_shaper_categorize adds Unicode 17/18 scripts (unreachable here: ScriptRun maps them to Common); normalization switches to normalizer_glyph_index and a variation-selector flag (no advance effect found). That is a T14.6.8 environment fact, not a packet defect.
